## Books

### AI Security Mastery
**URL**: https://ruwgxo.com/book  
**Source**: https://github.com/ruwgxo/ai-security-mastery  
**Status**: In progress (Ch 1-10 complete, Ch 11 in progress)  
**Description**: From ML Fundamentals to Production Detection Systems. 18 chapters, 182 sections, ~1080 pages. Covers ML basics, deep learning, NLP, modern LLMs, prompt injection, jailbreaks, data poisoning, model extraction, adversarial examples, and detection engineering. Free and open source under MIT licence.
